concerns.text: Task T016 implements a Linear Mixed-Model (LMM) with random intercepts, but the Spec (FR-005) and Plan (Phase 6) explicitly mandate a Fixed-Effects GLS with NO random intercepts. This task implements the wrong statistical model, failing to cover the actual requirement in the spec/plan.

Tasks T013a, T013b, and T013c are marked as incomplete ([ ]). These tasks are required to implement FR-014 (Validation), FR-012 (Collinearity/VIF), and FR-015 (Weighting). Without these tasks being implemented, the pipeline cannot satisfy these functional requirements.

Task T032 is marked as incomplete ([ ]). This task is required to implement SC-005 (Summit Match Verification) and US-3 (Visualization). The missing implementation prevents the system from verifying the summit-to-bigWig alignment required by the success criteria.

Task T049 references a '[deferred]' number of shuffles. The Plan (Phase 7) and Spec (FR-006) require a specific number of shuffles (10,000) to generate a valid empirical null distribution. The task description should be updated to reflect the concrete number (10,000) to ensure full coverage of the requirement.

Task T016 description cites 'FR-005' but implements an LMM, whereas the Plan and Research docs explicitly reject LMMs in favor of Fixed-Effects GLS. The task description is internally inconsistent with the plan's decision rationale.
